title: Foundations of Adobe Visual Design
hook: Master Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign—the essential Adobe trio every designer needs to communicate ideas visually and confidently.
description: Complete the O'Reilly course 'Adobe Visual Design: Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign for Beginners.' Build your creative foundation by learning how the Adobe ecosystem connects across print and digital design projects. By completing this, you'll strengthen your technical skillset and prepare for advanced coursework.
requirements: Access to O'Reilly Learning through your institution
Commitment to complete all Adobe Visual Design modules
reward: Adobe Foundations Badge. Confidence using Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

title: Revise, Refine & Build Your Design Projects
hook: Transform instructor feedback into polished, portfolio-worthy work using modern creative tools.
description: Take your project revision to the next level with the O'Reilly course 'Ultimate Graphic Design Course: Create 40 Practical Projects.' Apply what you’ve learned in class to refine layouts, experiment with typography, and finalize pieces that represent your best work. This challenge helps you strengthen your process and presentation.
requirements: Completion of a class project with instructor feedback
Revision and improvement using skills from the O'Reilly course
reward: Project Revision Badge. A stronger, more professional body of work.

title: Design Career Playbook: Freelance or Studio Pathways
hook: Learn how to present yourself as a professional designer—online, in person, and in your portfolio.
description: Explore 'Design Career Playbook: Navigate a Freelance or Studio Design Job' on O'Reilly. This course focuses on the practical side of creative careers—resumes, networking, interviews, and portfolio positioning. Perfect for students preparing to enter the design industry or launch freelance work.
requirements: Completion of a resume or portfolio draft
Willingness to apply professional and career guidance from the course
reward: Career Playbook Badge. A clearer direction for your professional design journey.

title: Brand Identity Systems: From Concept to Digital Implementation
hook: Build a cohesive personal or client brand system—logo, color, and typography unified across media.
description: Complete the O'Reilly course 'Brand Identity Systems: From Concept to Digital Implementation.' Learn how professional designers create consistent, meaningful brand identities that translate from print to digital. Perfect for students developing a personal brand or refining client projects.
requirements: Access to Adobe Illustrator and InDesign
Development of a logo, color palette, and type system for a personal or mock brand
reward: Brand Identity Badge. A polished, professional identity system ready for real-world use.

title: Online Portfolio & Social Presence: Designer’s Guide 2025
hook: Make your online design presence stand out—whether it’s your website, Behance, or social profiles.
description: Use the O'Reilly course 'Online Portfolio Sites & Social Presence: Designer’s Guide 2025' to elevate how you showcase work online. Learn how professional designers curate projects, write compelling descriptions, and maintain a cohesive visual brand across web and social channels.
requirements: Existing portfolio or work samples to showcase online
Interest in developing a cohesive digital presence across platforms
reward: Professional Presence Badge. A unified, standout online design brand.

title: Create an Outstanding Design Portfolio: Print & Digital
hook: Build a portfolio that reflects your craft, your process, and your growth as a designer.
description: Explore O'Reilly resources that guide portfolio creation and presentation for designers. Use these insights to design a portfolio—print or digital—that highlights your strongest work and communicates your creative process clearly.
requirements: Select and refine 3–5 projects that represent your best work
Create both print and digital versions of your design portfolio
reward: Portfolio Mastery Badge. A standout body of work ready for clients or employers.
